reference: AH-64D Longbow, placed from reference photos and guide pages (cockpit-refs/ah_64d): pilot from ah_64d_01.jpg and ah_64d_02.jpg (Paris Air Show pilot station) with Chuck's DCS AH-64D guide p-026 (pilot cockpit) and p-043/p-045 (fire panel, standby instruments): FIRE DET/EXTG panel top left, EUFD (its WCA field is the caution panel) top centre-right, two MPDs side by side, armament panel and keyboard unit on the left, standby attitude over standby airspeed and altimeter on the right, NVS/wiper panel under the MPDs; ah_64d_03.jpg for the MPD/EUFD proportions. CPG from guide p-077 and p-091: canopy jettison/fire/armament panel above the left MPD, EUFD above the right MPD, TEDAC display between them reaching the top row, keyboard below the left MPD and the wiper/processor panel below the right one; the CPG panel leans back 35 degrees so the top row fits above the MPDs under the low windscreen. MPDs and TEDAC drawn about 2x real (pilot MPDs 0.345, TEDAC 0.33, CPG MPDs 0.285). Controls: TM 1-1520-251-10 (pilot centre cyclic, CPG side-arm cyclic, collective and two power levers on the left).
